about: One answer of the Foundry agent strata-project-paper-writer through the Responses API, written by hand in the shape the API documents, because the gate's machine has no key. It writes the procurement summary for the Project Paper from the Northern Water Works Development Agency's plan of October 9, 2026, as of October 28, 2026, citing check_plan's and agency_track_record's summaries and rows, and the records the checked PPSD rows cite. Replace it with a recording: uv run --script ops/agent/record.py --env-file .env --writers
